title: רב חמא בר בוזי קמי' דרבה

paragraphs: Rav Chama bar Buzi, before Rabbah—I think it should read Rava—and Ravina were sitting before Rava. Ravina said to R. Chama, “You said in R. Yochanan's name.” Rava called them “children”: Bava Batra 16b. Ein Yaakov reads bar Bizna. He and Ravina visited the exilarch's house: Berakhot 50a.
